item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 16/May/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next few days. It will be hot with a few showers over the region. Besides, upper-air disturbances will bring showers and thunderstorms to southern China early to midweek next week.

Wind: South force 2 to 3.
Weather: Sunny periods and isolated showers. Hot during the day.
Temp range: 27 - 32 C
R.H. range: 65 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
